title: Preserve existing food material when merging party inventories
classification: Source-backed retained aggregate custody/material reset defect; normal supported producer sequence, not executed
contract_trace: Canonical item::requires_stable_object admits every food/measured unit as an individual physical object even without durability. Partial travel consumption retains row quantity1 and shrinks its lot nutrition/mass/value and canonical fraction. accept_party_join_request instead classifies transfer solely by repairable; non-repairable foods are passed by item_id+quantity to a grant factory and old inventory row is deleted. Factory constructs NEW physical object, WHOLE fraction, full canonical food nutrition/mass/value, new age and contamination. Thus valid partially consumed food is replenished by a successful merge and existing history/medicine/provenance is not transferred.
counterexample: A source-party leader with no active quest and a partly consumed carried travel_ration joins an open party at the same synchronized settlement/site. Catalog travel_ration has food capability with2500kcal and no durability; native Item default repairable=false and projection only sets true for durability. Normal consume_travel_food_to_zero ratio<0.999999 retains the quantity-one row with reduced material/fraction. Valid merge satisfies normal checks and calls fresh factory for quantity1: a whole2500kcal ration is created for recipient regardless of residual source material. Same mechanism resets age/contamination even for unconsumed aged food. No malformed row, MAX bound, runtime transaction or observed shipped actor asserted.

Consume existing physical-object custody and measured-material owners; reconcile all receiving signatures together. No compatibility adapter or duplicate food owner.
